meta.conflictRule: Data model, enums, tokens, hosting constraints: JSON wins. Behavior and UX: PRD wins. Deployment steps: DEPLOY_CPANEL.md wins. If still ambiguous: ask the owner.
meta.dataModelFormat: Each column is a string: 'name | type | constraints | note'. Logical types: bigint, text, json, int, decimal(p,s), bool, date, datetime, enum:<enumName>. Constraint tokens (space separated): pk, req, uniq, idx, default:<value>, fk:<table>.<column>, check:<expression>. Tables without 'appendOnly' also get the common columns. Tables with 'branchScoped' also get branch_id (fk branches.id, req, idx).
commonColumns: updated_at | datetime | req default:CURRENT_TIMESTAMP | on update CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
deleted_at | datetime | idx | soft delete marker; null = active
meta.appendOnlyRule: Append-only tables are never updated or deleted. Enforced in the application: Eloquent models throw on update/delete, no controller exposes them, and a feature test proves it. Corrections are new reversing rows. (cPanel does not allow a separate restricted DB user per table, so enforcement is in code and in the nightly integrity check.)
changeLog: 1.1.0: Removed Supabase/Postgres and every third-party database. Backend is Laravel (PHP) + MySQL/MariaDB created inside the owner cPanel hosting. All transactional logic moved from Postgres service/RLS to PHP services + policies. Added hosting and deployment sections.

engine.database: MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.5+ created in the owner cPanel (MySQL Databases / phpMyAdmin). InnoDB only. utf8mb4 / utf8mb4_unicode_ci (Bangla safe). No third-party database service.
forbiddenDbFeatures: anything needing root or SUPER privilege
engine.reason: Shared cPanel hosts usually do not grant SUPER/TRIGGER/ROUTINE privileges. All business logic lives in PHP services inside DB transactions.
engine.transactions: Laravel DB::transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (lockForUpdate) in deterministic id order; retry up to 3 times on deadlock (MySQL error 1213) and lock wait timeout (1205).
engine.idStrategy: BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT primary keys. Public/unguessable references use random tokens (verify_token, 40 chars), never sequential ids.
engine.timeStrategy: Store UTC in DATETIME(3). Application timezone config = UTC; display and day boundaries in Asia/Dhaka.
engine.dateDefaults: Date columns that default to today are set by the application, not by SQL defaults.
engine.jsonNote: JSON columns are nullable; null means empty object/array. MariaDB stores JSON as LONGTEXT with JSON_VALID check.
engine.searchStrategy: No trigram/GIN. POS search uses a maintained lowercase search_text column plus indexed sku, barcode, oem number_normalized and phone_primary; fitment lookup via composite index. LIKE scan over 10 000 variants must meet NFR-001; use FULLTEXT only if available on the host.
engine.uniquenessWithNulls: MySQL allows many NULLs in a unique index and has no partial indexes. Where uniqueness applies only to some rows, the table has a nullable computed key column (signature, trx_key, open_key, walkin_key) that holds the unique value for qualifying rows and NULL otherwise. The application maintains it inside the same transaction; a feature test proves the guard.

typeMapping.bigint: BIGINT UNSIGNED for ids and foreign keys; BIGINT for counters
typeMapping.text: VARCHAR(255) by default; TEXT when the column name contains description, note, notes, address, terms, policy, body, issue, resolution, reason, snapshot or payload; any text column that is uniq or idx must be VARCHAR(191) or shorter
typeMapping.decimal(p,s): DECIMAL(p,s); money decimal(14,2); quantity decimal(14,3); cost decimal(14,4)

meta.accessControl: Every API endpoint is guarded by auth middleware plus a Policy/Gate that reads role_permissions. Sensitive columns (cost, margin) are omitted by API Resources unless the user has the permission. There is no client-side database access of any kind. The access field on each table lists the permission keys that govern it.

rules: Use the original file only. Never redraw, recolor, crop, stretch or re-compress below 200 DPI at print size.
Place on white or navy-50 surfaces. On navy surfaces use a white rounded plate behind it.
Minimum width 120 px on screen, 35 mm on paper. Clear space equals the height of the O in ORBIN.
Collapsed sidebar shows the emblem region via CSS masking of the original file, not an edited copy.
Invoice embeds the original at full resolution.
Text on orange (accent) buttons is navy-900. Never white on orange-500.
Orange as text on white must use orange-700. Brand orange is for fills, indicators and chart accents only.
Primary text on white is neutral.text; secondary is neutral.textMuted (7.58:1).

motion.reducedMotion: Replace all motion with instant opacity change and disable Mirror Shine.
required: button press scale .97 with spring release and loading morph without width jump
drawer/modal scale .98 to 1 with backdrop blur 6px; right drawer slide 320ms
cart row enter with orange flash; qty flip; removal collapse 180ms
sale success animated check 600ms, invoice number type-in, download toast
toast slide from bottom-right 4s autodismiss pause on hover
Mirror Shine gloss sweep 700ms once per hover on accent/primary buttons, product cards, KPI cards, success screen

mirrorShine.description: Diagonal 20deg white-to-transparent band at 18% opacity sweeping across the element on hover; product cards also tilt up to 2deg following the pointer.

accent.rule: Max one per view; reserved for the hero action (Pay, Complete Sale).

card.hover: lift 2px + shadow.md for interactive cards only

sidebar.activeItem: 3px orange-500 left bar + navy-700 bg + white text

responsive.phone: read-only dashboards, stock lookup, invoice lookup

frontend: fetch/axios wrapper with Sanctum CSRF cookie handling
backend: PHP 8.2+ (if the host maximum is 8.1, use Laravel 10 and record it in docs/decisions.md)
Laravel Sanctum SPA cookie authentication (same-origin, httpOnly session cookie, CSRF)
Policies/Gates + permission middleware backed by role_permissions
Service classes for every transactional operation (see transactionalServices)
Laravel scheduler driven by one cPanel cron entry
Queue driver database or sync (no daemon workers on shared hosting)
SMTP mail via the hosting mailbox for password reset
database: MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.5+ in the owner cPanel
no stored procedures, triggers or events
pdfAndCodes: mPDF 8 (server side) for every PDF: invoice, receipt, credit note, quotation, PO, statements, Z-report. Supports Bangla (Noto Sans Bengali) with OpenType shaping. Built-in QR and barcodes.
@react-pdf/renderer only as a fallback if mPDF fails the host memory or Bangla test (decision recorded)
bwip-js on the client for barcode label preview; mPDF for label sheets
openspout for streaming CSV/XLSX export and import
PHP GD (Intervention Image) for server-side image resize and thumbnails
testing: Pest or PHPUnit feature tests against a MySQL test database (Docker locally) for services, endpoints, authorization matrix and invariants
tooling: GitHub Actions CI that also builds the release zip
techStack.hosting: Owner cPanel hosting. App on a dedicated subdomain (for example pos.example.com) whose document root points to backend/public. See hosting and DEPLOY_CPANEL.md.
techStack.swapRule: A library may be swapped only if it fails a stated requirement or a hosting limit; record the reason in docs/decisions.md.
forbidden: any third-party database or backend-as-a-service (Supabase, Firebase, PlanetScale, Neon, Appwrite and similar)
app code, .env, storage or vendor reachable from the public web root
raw hex colors outside the token file

hosting.summary: Owner cPanel hosting only. No third-party database or backend service.
owner_must_confirm: PHP version selectable in MultiPHP Manager (8.2 or higher preferred)
Select PHP Version / MultiPHP INI Editor: extensions and memory_limit as in nonFunctional.hosting
MySQL Databases and phpMyAdmin available; MySQL/MariaDB version (phpMyAdmin home page)
Composer available on the server (yes/no); if not, vendor is built locally and uploaded
Cron Jobs available with a 1-minute interval
Subdomain creation with custom document root
Disk space and inode limits (at least 5 GB free)
Backup tool available (JetBackup or cPanel Backup)

fallbacks.noSsh: Use the one-time web installer (FR-111); upload the release zip via File Manager and extract
fallbacks.lowMemory: Switch invoice PDF to the @react-pdf fallback and record the decision
fallbacks.noSubdomainDocroot: Place the contents of backend/public in public_html subfolder and keep the app outside public_html with an adjusted index.php path (documented in DEPLOY_CPANEL.md)

deployment.releaseArtifact: orbin-pos-release-<version>.zip built by CI or a local script: backend (with vendor, optimized autoload, no dev dependencies), built frontend inside backend/public, .htaccess files, no .env, no tests, no node_modules

layout.recommended: ~/orbin-pos/ (app, vendor, storage, .env) with subdomain document root ~/orbin-pos/public
layout.alternative: app in ~/orbin-pos/, public files in ~/public_html/pos/ with index.php paths adjusted

installSteps: create MySQL database and user in cPanel and add the user to the database with all privileges
create subdomain and point document root to the app public folder
create .env from the template with DB credentials, APP_URL, mail and a long random INSTALL_KEY
run migrations and seeders via SSH, or open /install with the INSTALL_KEY if no SSH
add the cron entry for the scheduler
enable HTTPS and verify forced redirect
open /admin/health and confirm all checks green

backups.cpanel: enable the hosting provider backups as a second layer
backups.offsite: owner downloads weekly backup to another device or cloud drive; admin page lists backups with download

update: upload and extract the new release over the app folder (keep .env and storage)
verify health page and one test sale in staging first
deployment.rollback: restore previous release zip and the pre-update database backup
securityChecklist: app, vendor, storage and .env outside the web root or protected by .htaccess
deny dotfiles and sensitive extensions via .htaccess
strong DB password, unique per environment
cPanel two-factor authentication enabled by owner
change the default super admin password at first login

api.errors: HTTP status + {code, message, fields, request_id}; codes listed per service

groups: auth (login, logout, me, password reset, idle-lock PIN verify)
vehicle-makes, vehicle-models, product-brands, categories, units, tax-rates
products, variants (matrix generate, clone, bulk-price), images, fitments, cross-references, import/export, labels
pos (variant search, customers quick-add, held bills)
sales (checkout, list, show, void, pdf, reprint), quotations, sale-returns, warranty-claims, shifts

root: backend/ (Laravel): app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1, app/Http/Requests, app/Http/Resources, app/Models, app/Policies, app/Services (NumberService, VariantSearchService, SaleService, SaleReturnService, GoodsReceiptService, StockPostingService, StockAdjustmentService, StockTransferService, StockCountService, PartyPaymentService, ShiftService, PeriodLockService, AuditService, PdfService, ImportExportService), app/Support (Money, BdtToWords, Permissions), app/Console/Commands (integrity:check, db:backup, stock:alerts), app/Pdf (Blade templates per document), database/migrations, database/seeders, resources/views (pdf/*, verify, app shell), routes/api.php, routes/web.php, tests/Feature, tests/Unit

frontend/ (React): src/app, src/design (tokens, tailwind preset, motion presets, base components), src/features/<feature> (components, hooks, api, schemas, types) for auth, settings, masterdata, catalog, inventory, purchasing, customers, pos, sales, ledger, reports, dashboard; src/lib (api client, money, format, permissions); src/locales (en.json, bn.json)
deploy/ (release packaging notes, .htaccess templates, cron examples, hosting-check page notes)
backend/public/assets/brand/orbin-logo.png (original logo, untouched; also copied to frontend public for the login screen)
projectStructure.build: Vite builds frontend/dist. The release step copies it into backend/public (index.html served as the SPA shell). Laravel handles /api/*, /sanctum/*, /verify/*, /files/*; every other non-file request falls back to the SPA shell.

routesNote: /verify/:token and /install are server-rendered Laravel pages (no SPA, no personal data). All other routes are SPA routes.

transactionalServices.note: Implemented as PHP service classes. Each transactional method runs inside one DB::transaction, locks rows in deterministic order, writes audit_logs, and is covered by feature tests for every error code. No stored procedures or triggers anywhere.

items.name: next_number
items.purpose: Gap-free document numbers (BR-070). Called inside the same DB transaction as the document insert; row locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
steps: lock sequence row for (key, branch, period)
reset counter if period changed per reset_policy

items.name: search_variants_by_vehicle
steps: join vehicle_fitments on model and year range
apply position filter (include pair and universal when relevant)
text match on name, sku, barcode, oem number_normalized, tags
items.output: variants with product name, image, spec, size_label, prices, stock, fitment note

items.name: complete_sale
items.purpose: Atomic checkout. The only way a completed invoice is created (FR-711).
input: cart (lines: variant_id, qty, unit_price_client, discount_type, discount_value, note, override_reason?)
payments[] (method, amount, account_id, tendered?, sender_number?, trx_id?, bank_name?, bank_ref?, transfer_date?, attachment_id?)
steps: read Idempotency-Key header; if a sale with the key exists return it unchanged (idempotent)
authorize pos.sell and require an open shift when require_open_shift
inside DB::transaction lock stock_levels rows with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE ordered by id; retry up to 3 times on deadlock
load variants; server recomputes price tier, discounts (BR-010), tax (BR-003), rounding (BR-001); reject if abs(total - client_expected_grand_total) > 0.01 with TOTAL_MISMATCH
enforce price floor and discount limit; require valid manager PIN when exceeded (BR-020, BR-021); audit override
enforce walk-in no due (BR-040) and credit limit (BR-041)
validate payments: references (BR-060), duplicate TrxID (BR-061), cash change math, no overpay on non-cash
expand bundles to components; verify stock for every component else INSUFFICIENT_STOCK with variant list
next_number('invoice') and insert sales with company, customer, vehicle snapshots and verify_token
insert sale_items with spec_snapshot, unit_cost from stock_levels.avg_cost (BR-031), warranty_until
insert sale_payments and account_transactions (in) per payment
insert party_ledger_entries: invoice debit, payment credits
return full sale snapshot (header, items, payments) for PDF

items.name: void_sale
steps: reject if period locked or any returns exist
reverse stock via sale_return-like movements marked void
set status = void with reason, actor, time

items.name: create_sale_return
items.purpose: Return or exchange against an invoice (BR-052).
steps: validate qty <= qty - qty_returned and return window
compute proportional refund including cart-discount share and tax
if status pending_approval wait for sales.return.approve
on post: resellable -> sale_return movement in; broken -> breakage movement; bundles return components

items.name: post_goods_receipt
items.purpose: Receive stock and compute landed cost (FR-503).
steps: allocate purchase_extra_costs to lines by value or quantity
insert purchase_receipt movements; insert damage movements for qty_damaged
update PO item received and PO status
supplier ledger credit for items_total + billed extras

items.name: post_stock_transfer
steps: send: transfer_out movements at source with cost
receive: transfer_in movements at destination carrying cost; weighted-average recalculated at destination

items.name: post_stock_count
steps: recompute variance against current system qty if movements happened since snapshot (reconcile)

items.name: record_party_payment
items.purpose: Customer receipt or supplier payment with allocation (FR-1002).
steps: insert party_payments, allocations, account_transactions, ledger entries

items.name: open_cash_shift
steps: reject if cashier already has open shift
insert shift and opening account transaction if float > 0

items.name: close_cash_shift
items.purpose: Close shift and produce Z-report data.
steps: expected_cash = opening_float + cash sales - cash refunds + cash in - cash out

items.name: lock_period
steps: reject moving lock backwards unless super_admin

rules: Upload validation by MIME sniffing and extension allow-list; never trust client file names
Disable PHP execution in uploads directories via .htaccess
Public upload paths use random names; private files never directly reachable

businessRules.BR-001: Money numeric(14,2); round half-up at line level; optional invoice round-off to nearest 1 BDT stored separately
businessRules.BR-002: Price tier by customer: retail/walk-in retail_price, wholesale wholesale_price, dealer/garage dealer_price; fallback retail
businessRules.BR-003: VAT inclusive or exclusive via setting; rate precedence variant, product, default
businessRules.BR-010: Line discount first; cart discount allocated proportionally to lines
businessRules.BR-020: Below floor price or over discount limit requires manager PIN, audited
businessRules.BR-021: Cashier max discount percent from settings
businessRules.BR-030: Stock deducted at sale completion; quotations and holds do not reserve unless reserve_on_hold
businessRules.BR-032: Weighted average recalculated on purchase receipts only; transfers carry cost
businessRules.BR-041: Credit limit warn or block, PIN override
businessRules.BR-050: Completed invoice immutable; void or return only
businessRules.BR-051: Void same day by manager+, any day super_admin, never in locked period
businessRules.BR-052: Return window default 7 days; refund <= paid; broken goes to breakage
businessRules.BR-060: MFS requires sender number + TrxID; bank requires bank name + reference
businessRules.BR-061: Duplicate TrxID per method blocked within 30 days unless manager override
businessRules.BR-062: Payments allocate oldest invoice first; remainder is advance
businessRules.BR-070: Gap-free numbering inside the document transaction
businessRules.BR-080: Period lock blocks create/edit/void on or before lock date
businessRules.BR-090: Asia/Dhaka display, UTC storage, week starts Saturday
businessRules.BR-091: left/right from driver seat view; driver_side setting default right
businessRules.BR-092: Variant uniqueness by product, position, size, glass, tint, finish, adjustment, feature hash
businessRules.BR-093: SKU and barcode globally unique including deactivated
businessRules.BR-094: Prices never negative; zero cost only for flagged samples

performance.note: Targets are for typical shared hosting; use query indexes, eager loading, response caching of master data, gzip/brotli via .htaccess, and long-lived cache headers for hashed assets

security: authorization on every endpoint (Policy + permission middleware) with a role x endpoint test matrix
Sanctum cookie auth: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, CSRF protection
login and PIN throttling (5 attempts then lock)
passwords hashed with Laravel Hash; no plaintext secrets anywhere
validation via Form Requests (server) and Zod (client)
prepared statements only (Eloquent/query builder); no raw string-built SQL
upload MIME sniffing, extension allow-list, no PHP execution in uploads
HTTPS forced, HSTS, security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy)
APP_DEBUG=false, .env and storage not web reachable
file permissions 644 files / 755 dirs, storage and bootstrap/cache writable only
reliability: atomic idempotent services; no partial sales
invariant tests and nightly integrity:check for stock and account balances
nightly DB backup with tested restore
nonFunctional.browsers: latest 2 versions Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari; Chrome on Android tablets
nonFunctional.banglaPdfGate: NFR-020 (mPDF is the primary engine; verify conjuncts render correctly)
testing: unit: money, VAT, discount allocation, avg cost, landed cost, BdtToWords, posting logic
feature: every service and endpoint, authorization matrix per role, invariants, concurrency (signature, trx_key, open_key, last-unit sale)
E2E: Playwright flows AT-001 to AT-023 where UI-testable

hosting.minPhp: 8.2 (8.1 allowed with Laravel 10 and a decision note)
hosting.cron: one entry every minute for the Laravel scheduler
hosting.ssh: preferred; installer wizard covers hosts without it

assumptions: Single shop at launch, multi-branch ready.
VAT configurable, default 0%; commercial invoice only, not NBR Mushak or EFD.
Invoice English by default; Bangla labels gated by NFR-020.
Payments are manual-entry in Phase 1; no gateway APIs.
Payment methods exactly Cash, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfer.
Original logo is the only logo source; never redrawn.
Backend is Laravel (PHP) with MySQL/MariaDB created in the owner cPanel; no third-party database or backend service is used.
The owner confirms the hosting capabilities listed in hosting.owner_must_confirm before P0; fallbacks exist for no SSH, no server Composer, PHP 8.1 only, and low memory.
Real-time updates are replaced by polling (30-60 s) for stock badges and notifications.
